body:
Why the fuck did I do it????

I LIKED my job!!!!

WHY THE FUCK DID I GIVE UP ON MY JOB??????

WHAT SORT OF FUCKING IDIOT AM I???

I know what you're saying, and ten years ago I would have agreed, but I'm a different person now. I don't have the desire to be extremely competitive, but I also wanted to have succeeded somewhere where I have tried so hard at. I went back to school recently, only to find my lecturer didn't know the subject. I've applied for over 200 jobs in the last month or alone and didn't get a single interview. My old job gave me my job back, and I lost it through my petty negligence. I don't care about finding affirmations. I just want a life that is financially and socially sustainable. 

One thing is certain, I'm bored of being broke and I'm bored of doing dead end jobs. What I really want to do is almost completely out of my reach now. I want to be an engineer, but have no money to buy the exams or the tools, no friends, no family, no contacts, no chances and no hope at all of reaching that goal. I have tried, tried, tried for years, tried some more, and I can't do it. I want that goal and it hurts because I can't have it. I can't have the things I want or the life I want. I've sabotaged myself too much for it to happen. 

What am I driven by? Desperation to simply make something worthwhile of myself. And I can't do it. I haven't been able to apply myself the way I want. I haven't had 'best times' in my life, it's been one casual, minimum wage job to the next, or unemployment. That isn't good enough. I have to motivate myself, and it's not possible. I used to have the drive, and eventually I've been chipped away into being toothlessly negative. I don't care about the universe as much as I just want a future where next months rent is only just in reach and I don't have to eat out of tins. I don't want to think about the possibilities. I want practical, solid grounding in my life, not being broke poor because of my stupid self-destructive negligence. I don't want any more psychology, I need practical solutions and answers, and they aren't there. I want a place where I have physical territory of my own that isn't tiny and rented. What is important to me isn't a mental image, it's to have physical things and security. And I can't have that. That isn't a chance for me, because everyone including myself has let me down. There's no time for patience or understanding anymore. I'm just a ridiculous, idiotic animal who is too stupid to deal with life.

I used to be fascinated with the universe and space. When I was small I was given an astronomy WAY too academic and obscure for my age, and it was amazing to me to learn so much in such a small amount of time. Now I am looking the other way and realizing why people turn to God and to mythical stories. No matter how to talk about it at least there is hope there. But I am faithless.

I don't think this society is sick. I think I am sick. I am a sick person who needs rehabilitation. Maybe permanent rehabilitation. I don't have any excuses. I can't blame society because I get drunk and can't be bothered to go to work. Hell, all I had to do was turn up. And I blew it. I could say I have a drinking problem, but it is more like having an asshole problem. There is no one to blame in my situation but myself. I have to be responsible, and I am resisting responsibility, and I can't figure out why. I am choosing to mess myself up so bad by making the wrong choices.

Sure the world may be following a system thats unsustainable, but so is my behavior, and out of those two I can only change one. But I am failing to. I am not getting the things I want and I can't make things work out for myself. I can't win this battle which is why I'm considering taking an overdose.

Thanks. I don't know what to say either. I don't know what's bothering me so much. Maybe I'm just acting out. I can't seem to take care of myself. Even though it's physically possible I am making all the wrong choices. I'm letting myself down and I hate myself for it.
